title: AutoOS shared LLM model catalogue
description: Single source of truth for every model AutoOS configures in OpenCode and OpenHands on every platform. Versions: prices in USD, contexts in tokens. Prices are per-token; OpenCode `cost` is derived per-1M (x1e6). Verified September 2026 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (free variants) and the LiteLLM price database (paid direct APIs).

id.description: Stable kebab-case key. OpenHands profile file is <id>.json; OpenRouter model id is openrouter/<openrouter_id>.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in model pickers.

openrouter_id.description: Model id on OpenRouter (incl. :free suffix for free variants). Omitted for always-local models.

direct.description: Direct (non-OpenRouter) access: OpenCode provider block + OpenHands base_url. Omitted for OpenRouter-only models.

input_price.description: USD per token while under the free cap. 0 for free variants.

paid_input_price.description: USD per token on the paid counterpart once the free cap is exhausted. Omitted when the model has no paid tier.

cache_read_price.description: USD per cached input token on the paid counterpart, when published.

default_for.description: Which API-key condition makes this the default model (opencode + openhands default selection).
